column1: # bash 3.2 portability rules, read by scripts/validate-package.sh.
# macOS ships bash 3.2.57 as /bin/bash and as the bash on PATH, so every shell
# script in this skill must stay within that dialect. `bash -n` cannot catch
# these: on bash 4+ they all parse, and `declare -A` degrades on 3.2 into an
# arithmetic error followed by a silently wrong result.
# This table lives outside the scripts it scans so the patterns can be written
# Format: <extended regex><TAB><reason>. Blank lines and # comments are ignored
# here, and comment-only lines in the scanned scripts are skipped, since a
# A `<<` rule must exclude `<<<`: a herestring is portable to bash 3.2.

column2: mapfile is bash 4; use a while IFS= read -r loop
readarray is bash 4; use a while IFS= read -r loop
declare -A is bash 4; use parallel indexed arrays
local -A is bash 4; use parallel indexed arrays
